summary: Exploratory Testing of Create Service-Scoped Roles (EVA-219)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Verify service selection persists after saving
Verify validation when no service is selected
Verify an expired service cannot be associated with a role
Verify removing a previously selected service
Verify expired services in the selection list
Verify switching from Selected Services Only to All Services
Verify switching from All Services to Selected Services Only
Verify saving a role without making changes

scenarios.title: Verify All Services option
preconditions: the user is viewing a role's Associated Services section
actions: the user selects "All Services" and saves the role
expectedResults: the role should be associated with all services in the organisation
the selected option should remain saved when the user reopens the role

scenarios.title: Verify Selected Services Only option
preconditions: the user is viewing a role's Associated Services section
actions: the user selects "Selected Services Only", chooses one or more active services, and saves the role
expectedResults: the selected services should be saved successfully
the selected services should remain selected when the user reopens the role

scenarios.title: Verify service selection persists after saving
preconditions: the user has selected an active service for a role
actions: the user saves the role and reopens it
expectedResults: the previously selected service should remain selected

scenarios.title: Verify validation when no service is selected
preconditions: the user has selected "Selected Services Only" for a role
actions: the user attempts to save without selecting any service
expectedResults: an appropriate validation message should be displayed
the role should not be saved with an empty service selection

scenarios.title: Verify an expired service cannot be associated with a role
preconditions: an expired service is displayed under "Selected Services Only"
actions: the user attempts to select the expired service and save the role
expectedResults: the system should prevent the expired service from being associated with the role, if expired services are not permitted by the business rules

scenarios.title: Verify removing a previously selected service
preconditions: a role has one or more services associated with it
actions: the user deselects a service and saves the role
expectedResults: the removed service should no longer be associated with the role
the updated selection should remain saved when the user reopens the role

scenarios.title: Verify updating service associations
preconditions: a role already has services associated with it (PASS)
actions: the user changes the selected services and saves the role
expectedResults: the updated service associations should be saved successfully
the updated selections should appear when the user reopens the role

scenarios.title: Verify expired services in the selection list
preconditions: the organisation has active and expired services
actions: the user opens the service list under "Selected Services Only"
expectedResults: expired services should not be displayed as available options
only eligible active services should be available for selection

scenarios.title: Verify switching from Selected Services Only to All Services
preconditions: a role has specific services selected under "Selected Services Only"
actions: the user switches to "All Services" and saves the role
expectedResults: "All Services" should remain selected when the user reopens the role

scenarios.title: Verify switching from All Services to Selected Services Only
actions: the user switches to "Selected Services Only", selects one or more active services, and saves the role
expectedResults: "Selected Services Only" and the selected services should remain saved when the user reopens the role

scenarios.title: Verify saving a role without making changes
preconditions: the user opens an existing role with saved service associations
actions: the user saves the role without making any changes
expectedResults: the role should be saved without errors
the existing service associations should remain unchanged
